title: kbfacts.parse_tag reads only the first source of [CODE S-a: path; S-b: path], so the second id of such tags is not cited
goal: SP-5x5ut5ko retrospective (ST-owuunsvl's worker): parse_tag splits a tag on ';' and drops a part with no kind, so [CODE S-a: path; S-b: path] cites S-a only; kb/public/agents/codebase-mapping.md:62, :75, :87, :88, :127 and others use that form, so their second sources have no citation and no anchor. Each source of such a tag is cited, by the parser or by the tags rewritten with a kind per part, and check.py or the lint names the form.

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import kbfacts;p=kbfacts.parse_tag('[CODE S-sipjyeoi: internal/a.go; S-gfjnysog: internal/b.go]');ids=[i for x in p for i in x['ids']];print('ids parsed:',ids);sys.exit(0 if 'S-gfjnysog' in ids else 1)
